issues.desc: PLAN phase should populate userSees for each checklist item before story_review (CLAUDE.md requires it, INIT skipped — acceptable but flag for PLAN).
CHK-002 (policy/scope decision for test-evidence.json) overlaps with PLAN decision_set deliverable; ensure it feeds decision_set.options/chosen/rationale rather than producing an orphan policy doc.

Checklist items lack userSees fields. Per CLAUDE.md spec, each item should declare the precise user-observable text post-completion. Activities are listed (reproduce/define/implement/test/validate) but no item pins the visible end-state.

End-state acceptance is not crystallized in checklist. Background.md implies success = after DONE commit, `koala session_brief` shows no stale advisory for test-evidence.json. Recommend adding an explicit observable to CHK-005 (e.g., transcript showing session_brief output WITHOUT stale block AND a separate transcript showing a genuine material drift IS still flagged) so implementer cannot narrowly pass without confirming the user-visible loop is gone.
